title: Map-Specific Procedural World Proposal Workbench over PCA
objective: Implement one map-specific procedural world proposal workbench over PCA-owned recipe/seed/cache execution, with independently previewable, regenerable, rejectable and owner-promotable proposal packs for geography/elevation; hydrology/climate/biome/resources; and population/settlement/culture/state/routes/trade, without taking generic PCA generation authority or canonical owner-domain mutation authority.

scope.purpose: Provide one map-specific procedural proposal workbench over the PCA recipe/seed/cache substrate while retaining generic generation execution in PCA and keeping owner promotion explicit.
included: hydrology, climate, biome and resource proposal pack
population, settlement, culture, state, route and trade proposal pack
independent preview, regeneration, rejection and owner-promotion receipts over PCA substrate
scope.completion_gate: Representative MCS maps can deterministically configure and inspect map-specific PCA-backed proposal packs, preserve independent preview/regeneration/rejection/promotion boundaries, and leave generic generation execution and canonical owner mutation outside MCS authority.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 and MCS_PROGRAM_BACKLOG.json were reconsulted after MCS-08 exact-tree publication. No cross-program rotation detour supersedes the surviving MCS strict order, so MCS-10 is selected.
MCS-10 absorbs baseline MCS-11 and MCS-12 into one map-facing procedural proposal workbench over the shared PCA recipe/seed/cache substrate.
Generic recipe, DAG, seed, cache and generation execution remain PCA-owned; MCS-10 consumes PCA capabilities and shared dependencies rather than replacing them.
Proposal categories remain independently previewable, regenerable, rejectable and owner-promotable; selection does not authorize canonical owner-domain mutation.
MCS-10 is selected_not_started only; no implementation branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue.
MCS-13, PCA-16, MCCS, MRCS, MSAS, MNCS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized by this selection.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue. On that command, governed-start MCS-10 with the OPS3 execution guard; do not implement while selected_not_started.

stop_reason.evidence: MCS-10 is selected_not_started after fresh post-MCS-08 DAG reconciliation; no bounded MCS-10 execution is active.
